name: caret-wipe
title: Caret Wipe
description: A tall text caret sweeps across the frame: behind it the new scene is typed in, ahead of it the old scene is backspaced away. Built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .crw-panel elements) make it preview on its own; to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels with your scenes (or set them to your full-frame clips) and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Tech, code or writing contexts where a text cursor is a natural metaphor.
A scene change that should read as typed or deleted text.
avoidWhen: The tone is organic or cinematic: use a lens or focus transition.
The caret color clashes with the brand and cannot be changed.
author: Remocn
